title: German-Style Flatbread
description: A traditional German flatbread recipe made with simple ingredients.
instructions: 1. In a large mixing bowl, combine flour and salt.
2. Gradually add in warm water, mixing until a dough forms.
3. Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes until smooth.
4. Divide the dough into 4-6 equal pieces.
5. Roll out each piece into a thin circle, about 1/8 inch thick.
6. Heat a non-stick skillet over medium-high heat.
7. Cook the flatbreads for 1-2 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
9. Serve warm or at room temperature.
